project_type: Node.js/Express + MongoDB backend, Android (Kotlin) mobile app, React/Vite admin dashboard
language: JavaScript (ES modules) for backend, Kotlin for Android, JSX/React for dashboard
build_system: Backend: node (package.json, ES modules with import/export). Android: Gradle (Groovy DSL, compileSdk 34, minSdk 24). Dashboard: Vite (npm run dev / npm run build).
test_framework: No automated test runner currently configured. Verification is manual: start the backend with `node server.js`, run the Android app in Android Studio, and open the dashboard with `npm run dev` inside dashboard/.
build_command: Backend: `node server.js` (or `npm start`). Android: Build in Android Studio (Build > Make Project). Dashboard: `npm run build` in dashboard/.
test_command: Manual. For backend endpoints: `curl` or Postman against http://localhost:8000. For Android: run on emulator/device. No automated test suite exists.
verification_instructions: 1. Start backend: cd to workspace root, run `node server.js`. 2. Test endpoints with curl/Postman using a valid JWT. 3. Build Android app in Android Studio, run on device/emulator. 4. Start dashboard: cd dashboard, run `npm run dev`. 5. Check MongoDB collections in Atlas or mongo shell.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that are checked in. google-services.json must be placed at hookaDrop App/HookahDrop/app/google-services.json manually after downloading from Firebase console.
environment_constraints: Backend .env must have FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY (JSON string or file path), FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET, MONGODB_URI. FCM Admin SDK is not yet installed. google-services.json must be downloaded from Firebase console — cannot be generated by code. The Android BASE_URL in ApiClient.kt points to the backend; ensure the emulator uses 10.0.2.2 or device uses the LAN IP.
contribution_requirements: Reuse existing architecture. No duplicate models or collections. All notification events must be triggered by real backend events. Do not expose Firebase credentials in the Android app. Use existing UI patterns (dark/cyan/gold theme). ES module syntax (import/export) throughout backend.
key_patterns: Backend: controllers export named async functions, routes import them, server.js mounts routes at /api. Auth: protectRoute middleware sets req.user from JWT. All route files use ES module default export of an Express router. Android: Activities use ViewBinding (b.xxx), ApiClient.get/post/put return ApiResponse, SessionManager reads/writes SharedPreferences. Dashboard: api.js axios instance with Bearer token interceptor, pages are JSX components, Sidebar.jsx has allNavItems array, App.jsx has Routes.
directory_structure: Root: backend files (server.js, models/, controller/, routes/, middleware/, storage/). 'hookaDrop App/HookahDrop/': Android app (app/src/main/java/com/hookahdrop/app/ for Kotlin sources, app/src/main/res/ for layouts/drawables). 'dashboard/': React/Vite admin app (src/pages/, src/components/, src/utils/, src/store/). No 'services/' directory currently exists.
